unlisted_practices: Conduct cost-benefit analyses of AI scribe technologies to justify their expense.
Involve clinician end users in the co-design and development of AI scribes.
Directly measure patients' and caregivers' experiences, preferences, and patient-reported outcomes with AI scribes.
Systematically collect data on clinical errors and negative patient outcomes attributable to AI scribe use.
Evaluate AI scribes across diverse clinical specialties, disciplines, and practice settings, including nonphysician clinicians.
Investigate the effects of AI scribes on clinical reasoning, cognition, and trainee expertise development.

screen.reason: This is an editorial outlining the potential and challenges of ambient AI scribes and calling for responsible deployment and research.
